execution_review: Readable ESM source; invokedAsScript checks realpath-normalized argv[1] before running the installer CLI. No encoded executable payload or dynamic evaluation.

Explicit --project and --platform select the destination. The installer copies the co-shipped AWS bootstrap, sets owner-only 0700 mode, merges Cursor install configuration and Copilot setup workflow, and writes operator documentation.
The Copilot workflow uses workflow_dispatch, contents: read, checkout with persist-credentials: false, a configured repository secret and the local AWS bootstrap script.
The shell bootstrap optionally installs prerequisites with sudo and downloads the pinned AWS CLI zip from awscli.amazonaws.com. GPG verifies its signature before extraction and installation.

Bootstrap key material comes from the configured JSON environment secret and is written to local named AWS profiles with restrictive modes. Role/account verification uses AWS STS. Optional observer checks are read-only AWS queries. No unrelated external credential recipient occurs in the traced code.

Package postinstall invokes install-claude-plugins.sh, install-generated-artifact-merge-driver.mjs and an optional TypeScript build. The shell helper exits on the postinstall lifecycle; the merge-driver helper checks a local script and mapped .gitattributes entries. Neither invokes the AWS workflow installer.
judgment_basis: Ordinary governance and explicitly invoked remote-agent setup, consistent with the package purpose; no behavior change beyond dependency and release maintenance. Actual operator authorization, runtime AWS policy and deployment context are not supplied.

external_regression.name: @lystech/core
external_regression.review: The shipped postinstall contains a push-triggered workflow template that constructs owner/repo/repoId metadata and sends it with curl POST to an external package-registry API. The helper has package/dependency/environment guards, so static template coverage does not assert runtime success. Its hostile composite is preserved, including when the output variable is renamed. This is a regression source outside the requested verdict batch, not a new verdict for that package.

material_losses: Only the unsupported postinstall/workflow inference was removed; the same destinations remain notable. All other per-member findings and the external hostile composite are unchanged.
classifier_disagreements: None for Lisa: ML is BENIGN both before and after. The external regression retains a hostile registry-workflow rule while its ML class remains BENIGN, a pre-existing discrepancy rather than newly lost rule coverage.
analysis_limitations: Static analysis; no package lifecycle, cloud credentials, downloaded CLI or generated workflow was executed.
